name: ThinkSLM
description: ThinkSLM is the first extensive benchmark designed to systematically evaluate the reasoning abilities of small language models (SLMs), including those trained from scratch or derived from LLMs via quantization, pruning, and distillation. It evaluates 72 diverse SLMs across 17 reasoning benchmarks and establishes reliable evaluation criteria comparing methods and LLM judges against human evaluations.
reputation: A recent benchmark that has gained attention for evaluating reasoning in small language models and for comparing model-side and judge-side evaluation against humans.
notes: Focuses on reasoning evaluation of small language models and includes a publicly available leaderboard.
